hypothesis: With fixed dual momentum entries and joint-close 60bp stop/3R target, changing maximum intraday hold alone may improve net capture; no overnight extension.
eligibility: At least 20 rounds in all six development cells
selection: Eligible top1 by worst net return, then mean return, then hold; freeze before diagnostics
promotion: All six development returns positive, every delta versus refreshed anchor positive, every MDD no worse than anchor. Otherwise reject, even rank1.
data_change: Redownload changed hash; old hash unavailable, refresh all comparators; never claim identical-input reproduction.
concurrency: No local worker/lock found; remote head checked twice unchanged. External worker absence cannot be proven. Distinct output directory; normal non-force push only.
